name: io.github.Goran-Arsov/freshjots-mcp
description: Read and write your Fresh Jots notes from Claude, Cursor, and any MCP client.
title: Fresh Jots

environmentVariables.name: FRESHJOTS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Fresh Jots API token. Create one at https://freshjots.com/settings/api_tokens (Dev or Team plan).

environmentVariables.name: FRESHJOTS_PASSPHRASE
environmentVariables.description: Optional passphrase for transparent client-side encryption. When set, create_note/append_to_note accept encrypt:true and read_note accepts decrypt:true — Fresh Jots then stores only ciphertext it cannot read.
